ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَانْشُرْ طَرِيْقَتَنَا فِيْ سَائِرِ الْبِلَادِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa ‘nshur tarīqatanā fī sā’iri ‘l-bilād.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and spread our order (Tariqah) in all the lands!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَعَمِّرْ بِسَوَاطِعِ أَنْوَارِهَا كُلَّ مَنِ اشْتَغَلَ بِهَا مِنْ كُلِّ حَاضِرٍ وَبَادٍ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa `ammir bi sawāṭi`i anwārihā kulla mani ‘shtaghala bi hā min kulli ḥāḍirin wa bād.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and supply by its radiant lights whoever attends to it from everyone present and in the past!
